# artifactapi_virtual (Data Source)

Read an existing ArtifactAPI virtual repository.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the configuration of an existing virtual repository by name.
# Returns the package type, description, and ordered member list.
data "artifactapi_virtual" "helm" {
  name = "helm"
}

output "helm_members" {
  value = data.artifactapi_virtual.helm.members
}

output "helm_package_type" {
  value = data.artifactapi_virtual.helm.package_type
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Virtual repository name.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Human-readable description.
- `managed_by` (String) What manages the repository (e.g. terraform).
- `members` (List of String) Ordered list of member remote names.
- `package_type` (String) Package type of the virtual repository.
- `parallel_fetch` (Boolean) Whether member index files are fetched concurrently.
